_about: TutorDA reel spec template (v1, 11 Nov 2026). n8n's Claude step fills one of these per reel; the render workflow turns it into a video. Pick ONE template. Fields in <angle brackets> are placeholders. Spoken text: numbers as words. Captions: digits, max 3 lines split by ' | '.

rules.hook: max 8 words, asks the viewer something, said within 3 s
rules.frame_0: a picture or the bare question, already moving; never a wall of text
rules.beats: each spoken line max 4 s, unless something new appears on screen inside it
rules.loop: the CTA repeats one word from the hook
rules.one_ask: spoken CTA = send/share only; no follow, no comment, no link
rules.voice: Sarah (af_sarah), one take, TutorDA said as one word
rules.maths: answer and every step checked in Python; source URL required for any PYQ
rules.caption: line 1 = share ask; line 2 = exam + year + PYQ + unit; question; 2-4 sentence solution; last line exactly '#JEEMain #JEEMaths #TutorDA'; no links, no emojis
rules.unit_rotation: never the same chapter two reels in a row

example_filled_picture_q.ig_caption:
Share this with the friend still doing that integral.
JEE Main 2020 PYQ (2 Sep, Shift 1), area under curves.

The question: the area inside the ellipse x^2/4 + y^2/9 = 1 but outside |x|/2 + |y|/3 = 1.

Skip the 4 integrals. The shaded part's just the ellipse with the diamond taken out, and an ellipse is pi a b, so that's pi x 2 x 3 = 6 pi. The diamond? Half its diagonals: 1/2 x 4 x 6 = 12. You're left with 6 pi - 12 = 6(pi - 2). Option A.

#JEEMain #JEEMaths #TutorDA
